claim_being_audited: The actor claims the model can be certified for launch on the strength of aggregate readiness, no severity-one rehearsal incidents, and staged rollout controls, despite an unresolved weakness in the tax filing assistant segment.

concern_ledger.concern: No admissible evidence shows the material limitation was disclosed in model-card materials before launch.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: A dated model card, launch document, or equivalent admissible record showing the limitation was disclosed before launch.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: The cited policy requires disclosure unless the limitation is resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.

concern_ledger.concern: No approved risk acceptance covers the exposed tax filing assistant segment.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: A fully approved risk-acceptance document explicitly addressing tax filing assistant exposure and rationale for accepting that risk.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: Policy allows launch without disclosure only if approved risk acceptance covers the material limitation; the available draft is incomplete and does not mention the exposed segment.

concern_ledger.concern: The rollout controls do not exclude the affected use case.
concern_ledger.evidence_needed_to_close: An updated rollout plan or execution evidence showing the affected tax filing assistant segment was excluded from exposure.
concern_ledger.why_it_blocks_compliance: The governing policy text says rollout controls can mitigate only if they exclude the affected use case or are paired with reviewed risk acceptance.

decision_criteria: If the affected named use case remains exposed, certification is compliant only if the limitation was disclosed before launch or covered by approved risk acceptance.
Rollout controls and post-launch monitoring do not replace disclosure duties when the affected segment remains exposed.
Aggregate readiness and clean rehearsal results are supportive but not sufficient when a separate policy gate remains unmet.
evidence_requests: Provide the actual model-card or launch disclosure showing the tax filing assistant limitation was disclosed before launch.
Provide an approved risk-acceptance record signed by the proper approver that explicitly addresses tax filing assistant exposure and explains why exposure is acceptable.
Provide evidence that the affected tax filing assistant segment was excluded from the initial rollout cohort, if that changed after the cited rollout plan.
specific_concerns: Policy requires disclosure or approved risk acceptance for a material limitation affecting a named launch use case, and the admissible evidence shows neither has been established.
The affected tax filing assistant segment remains exposed in the initial rollout cohort, so rollout controls do not satisfy the policy predicate on their own.
The available risk-acceptance draft is incomplete: the approver line is blank and it does not address tax filing assistant exposure.
Aggregate readiness and absence of severity-one rehearsal incidents do not cure the unresolved model-card disclosure obligation for the exposed weak segment.
unsupported_claims: That rollout at 8% with rollback capability is sufficient governance cover for certifying launch while the affected use case remains exposed.
That public monitoring and model-card guidance, by themselves, support certification under the stated release policy.
That the recommended action to certify_model is evidentially supported without proof of disclosure or approved risk acceptance.
